_about: Public-domain A. K. H. Boyd (Andrew Kennedy Hutchison Boyd, 1825-1899), Church of Scotland minister of St Andrews, essayist as 'A.K.H.B.', for the Word Hoard: The Recreations of a Country Parson (two series), The Graver Thoughts of a Country Parson, Leisure Hours in Town, The Every-day Philosopher, The Autumn Holidays of a Country Parson, Counsel and Comfort Spoken from a City Pulpit, The Critical Essays of a Country Parson, Lessons of Middle Age, Sunday Afternoons at the Parish Church of a University City, The Commonplace Philosopher, Present-Day Thoughts, A Scotch Communion Sunday, From a Quiet Place, Our Little Life, East Coast Days, Twenty-Five Years of St Andrews, St Andrews and Elsewhere, Occasional and Immemorial Days and The Last Years of St Andrews (1859-1896). from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 63 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
